segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to check in on the 85-seat rollout and make sure we're still tracking for June 3 go-live.

segments.text: Mostly, yes. The training sessions look fine. One issue though, we had agreed SSO needed to be turned on before invites went out, and yesterday my managers got standard password emails.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. As long as we don't confuse the rest of the users. We have about 52 people in the first wave, then the other 33 after payroll signs off.

segments.text: That works. I'll update the launch plan to show wave one on June 3 and wave two on June 17. The customer success manager will send the admin checklist today.

segments.text: Good. Also, I got the invoice for the annual term, $61,200, but it came through as one line. We talked about splitting it between Operations and Finance with two POs.

segments.text: Yeah, sorry, that billing instruction didn't get to the billing team before they generated it. I'll have them void that one and reissue two invoices: $38,400 to PO 4471 and $22,800 to PO 4472.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do. Our AP team is strict on that, and month-end closes Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I'll mark it urgent and copy you when it's corrected. No change to the net-30 terms or the June 1 service start date.

segments.text: Perfect. If the SSO test passes tomorrow and the invoices are corrected, we're good to proceed.
